environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed via AWS Cloud Map into an EKS-managed Fargate profile with Kubernetes NetworkPolicy enforcement through Calico CNI plugin (v3.26+). A GlobalNetworkPolicy named 'deny-link-local-egress' applies label-selector matching all pods in the 'production' namespace with spec.egress rules that deny traffic to CIDR 169.254.0.0/16 on all ports. Additionally, a second NetworkPolicy 'restrict-outbound-proxy' limits egress from the app pod to only the upstream API CIDR range (10.0.0.0/8) and the cluster DNS (kube-dns at 172.20.0.10/32 port 53). The Fargate profile's pod execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/FargateNoMetadataBoundary) that includes an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole for the task credential provider. Container also runs with a read-only root filesystem and drops NET_RAW capability.

config.platform: EKS Fargate Profile with Calico CNI v3.26
